test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow correctly enforces document checks and governance approvals before a site can be activated for a clinical trial.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is installed and accessible
Test user accounts with Study Manager and CRA roles are created
A test study is configured in the system
Document templates (e.g., FDA 1572, CV) are available for upload

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS as a Study Manager and navigate to the Site Management module for the test study.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access the site management interface for the specified study.

test_steps.action: Initiate the site activation workflow for a new test site and attempt to advance the status to 'Ready to Enroll' without uploading required documents.
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents status change and displays an error message listing the missing required documents (e.g., FDA 1572, CV, Lab Certification).

test_steps.action: Upload all required documents for the test site into the CTMS document repository.
test_steps.expected_result: Documents are successfully uploaded, and the system confirms all required documents are present and accounted for.

test_steps.action: As a Study Manager, complete the final approval step in the site activation workflow.
test_steps.expected_result: System allows the status change to 'Activated' and the site status is updated accordingly, indicating it is ready for subject enrollment.

acceptance_criteria: The system enforces a predefined checklist of required documents before site activation can be completed.
The workflow transitions correctly between states (e.g., Initiation, Document Collection, Review, Activated) based on user actions.
An audit trail entry is generated for each state change and document upload event.
Only users with the 'Study Manager' role can perform the final activation approval.
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 (R2) Section 5.20.1 requires documentation of investigator qualifications and agreements prior to trial initiation.
Internal procedure SOP-CTMS-005: Site Activation and Management.
data_integrity_requirements: ALCOA+ principles must be maintained for all uploaded site documents.
The audit trail must capture the user, timestamp, and action for all workflow state changes.
urs_requirements: URS-027-002: Implement site activation workflow with required document checks.

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Access Control for CRO and Sponsor Users
test_cases.objective: Validate that user access permissions are correctly enforced based on configured roles, ensuring CRO users cannot access sponsor-specific functions and data.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is installed and accessible
Test user accounts are created with 'Sponsor Study Manager' and 'CRO CRA' roles
A test study is configured with sites assigned to the CRO
Financial management module is configured with payment data

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS using the 'CRO CRA' test user account.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and is presented with a dashboard or menu appropriate for the CRO CRA role.

test_steps.action: Attempt to navigate to the Financial Management module and view payment details or milestone rules.
test_steps.expected_result: System denies access, either by not showing the module link or by displaying an 'Access Denied' message when the URL is directly accessed.
data_to_capture: Presence/Absence of Financial Management menu option

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify the study-level configuration or governance checkpoints for the test study.
test_steps.expected_result: System denies access to configuration settings, as this action is restricted to sponsor roles.
data_to_capture: Available actions/buttons in study configuration screens

test_steps.action: Log out and then log in using the 'Sponsor Study Manager' test user account.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and has access to the Financial Management module and study configuration settings.
data_to_capture: Modules accessible to Sponsor Study Manager

test_steps.action: As the Sponsor Study Manager, verify access to all modules and confirm the ability to modify study configurations.
test_steps.expected_result: Sponsor user has full access to all configured modules and functions, including financial data and study setup.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of access to financial data
Confirmation of ability to save study configuration changes

acceptance_criteria: User permissions are strictly enforced based on their assigned role (CRO vs. Sponsor).
CRO users cannot access or view financial information or study-level system configurations.
Sponsor users have appropriate access to all system modules and configuration options.
Access attempts to unauthorized areas are logged in the audit trail.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11.10(d) requires system access to be limited to authorized individuals.
ICH E6 (R2) emphasizes controlled access to trial data to ensure integrity and confidentiality.
data_integrity_requirements: Access control rules must prevent unauthorized creation, modification, or deletion of critical study data.
All successful and failed login attempts must be recorded in an audit trail.
urs_requirements: URS-027-007: Enforce role-based access for CRO and sponsor users.
related_tests: PQ-004 (User Acceptance Testing with Role Scenarios)

test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Checks
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow properly validates required documents before allowing site activation
prerequisites: CTMS system configured with site activation workflow
Test study created
Test user accounts with appropriate permissions
Test site documents available

test_steps.action: Log in as a clinical operations user and navigate to site management module
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access site management functions

test_steps.action: Initiate site activation process for a test site and attempt to activate without uploading required documents
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents activation and displays error message listing missing required documents

test_steps.action: Upload all required documents (protocol, IB, ICF, etc.) and submit for activation
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts documents and allows activation request submission

test_steps.action: Verify that the workflow transitions through configured approval steps with appropriate e-signatures
test_steps.expected_result: Workflow progresses through all required approval steps with 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signatures

acceptance_criteria: Site activation prevented without required documents
All required documents properly validated
Workflow progresses through configured approval steps
E-signatures comply with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic signatures
ICH GCP guidelines for site activation documentation
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail records all document uploads and workflow transitions
E-signatures are non-repudiable and timestamped

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Configuration with Milestone Rules
test_cases.objective: Validate that the configured payment rules correctly calculate investigator payments based on milestone achievements and tax withholding
prerequisites: Payment module configured with milestone rules
Test study with payment terms
Test sites with subject enrollment data
Tax withholding rules configured

test_steps.action: Log in as finance user and navigate to payment management module
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully accesses payment management functions

test_steps.action: Create test payment run for sites that have achieved various milestones (first subject enrolled, 50% enrollment, etc.)
test_steps.expected_result: System correctly identifies achieved milestones and calculates appropriate payments

test_steps.action: Verify tax withholding calculations based on configured rules and site location
test_steps.expected_result: System applies correct tax withholding percentages based on site country and payment type

test_steps.action: Generate payment reports and review for accuracy and completeness
test_steps.expected_result: Payment reports include all required information with accurate calculations and proper formatting

acceptance_criteria: Payments calculated correctly based on milestone achievements
Tax withholding applied according to configured rules
Payment reports generated accurately
Financial records retained per retention policy
data_integrity_requirements: Payment calculations are accurate and reproducible
Financial records are immutable once approved
Audit trail tracks all payment modifications

test_cases.test_name: Monitoring Visit Workflow and Reporting Configuration Test
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured monitoring visit planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up workflows function correctly using vendor templates.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible with valid user credentials
Test study and site data are created
Monitoring visit templates are configured

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS with a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) role and navigate to the monitoring visit planning module.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access the monitoring visit planning interface for assigned sites.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the monitoring visit planning dashboard

test_steps.action: Schedule a new monitoring visit for a test site, specifying the visit type, planned date, and objectives.
test_steps.expected_result: The monitoring visit is successfully created and appears in the visit calendar and CRA's task list.

test_steps.action: Complete a monitoring trip report using the configured vendor template, entering findings and observations.
test_steps.expected_result: The trip report template loads correctly, and all data is saved upon submission.

test_steps.action: Generate and send a follow-up letter to the site from within the completed trip report.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates a follow-up letter using the configured template and logs the action.
data_to_capture: Record of the sent letter in the audit trail

acceptance_criteria: Monitoring visits can be planned and scheduled without errors.
Trip reports are completed using the correct template and all data is saved.
Follow-up letters are generated and associated with the correct visit report.
All actions are recorded in the system audit trail.
regulatory_basis: Sponsor's SOP for Monitoring Clinical Investigations
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture creation and modification of all visit-related records.
Trip report data must be immutable once approved and signed.

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Milestone and Tax Configuration Test
test_cases.objective: Validate the configuration of payment rules, including milestone triggers and automatic tax withholding calculations.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible with a Financial Manager role
Test study with a site and subject enrollment data exists
Payment milestone rules are configured

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS with a Financial Manager role and navigate to the payments module.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access the financial management and payment configuration sections.

test_steps.action: Simulate the completion of a payment milestone (e.g., first subject enrolled) for a test site.
test_steps.expected_result: The system automatically generates a payment request for the correct amount upon milestone completion.

test_steps.action: Review the generated payment request to verify the automatic calculation of tax withholding based on the site's country.
test_steps.expected_result: The net payment amount is correctly calculated after applying the configured tax withholding percentage.

test_steps.action: Approve the payment request and verify the entry in the financial audit log.
test_steps.expected_result: The payment is approved, and a complete record is created in the financial audit trail.

acceptance_criteria: Payment milestones are triggered automatically upon meeting defined study events.
Tax withholding is calculated correctly based on the site's location.
Payment requests and approvals are recorded in an immutable audit trail.
Financial reports accurately reflect the payment status.
data_integrity_requirements: Financial calculations must be accurate and reproducible.
All payment transactions must have a complete and unalterable audit trail.
